group.label: General
group.comment:
Fills Related Products, Up-Sells, Cross-Sells and Frequently Bought Together from the rules under Marketing → Auto Product Link Rules. A default rule for each ships with the module, so the whole catalog is linked on the first cron run. Links the module writes are recorded in a ledger, so products you linked by hand are never moved, overwritten or deleted. Needs the magenx_auto_link_apply_rules cron running.
Note: Magento stores product links globally — catalog_product_link has no store, website or customer-group column — so a rule's store setting only decides which store's attribute values, prices and orders are read, not who sees the resulting links.

field.label: Enable Auto Product Links
field.comment: When disabled both cron jobs return immediately and nothing is written. Existing auto links stay in place.

field.label: Dry Run
field.comment: Compute every change and write it to var/log/magenx_auto_product_links.log without touching the catalog.

field.label: Invalidate Product Cache After a Run
field.comment: Broadcasts a cat_p_<id> cache identity for every product whose links changed, which is what lets the headless storefront drop its cached related/up-sell/cross-sell rails immediately instead of waiting for its own TTL. Requires Full Page Cache in Varnish mode and a configured http_cache_hosts; without those nothing is broadcast and new links appear only when the storefront cache expires.

field.label: Default Maximum Links per Product
field.comment: Used when a rule leaves its own limit empty. Counts auto links only — links you added by hand are additive and never capped.

field.label: Auto Link Position Offset
field.comment: Auto links are numbered from this position upward, so hand-picked links (normally 1, 2, 3…) always sort ahead of them. Raise it if you position manual links above 1000.

group.label: Run Limits
group.comment: Every run processes every product a rule matches; these only bound memory and transaction size.

field.label: Maximum Candidate Products per Rule
field.comment: Caps the pool a rule's "Link To These Products" conditions may resolve to; an empty condition means the whole catalog. A rule over the cap is skipped with an error in the log and keeps its existing links.

field.label: Products per Batch
field.comment: How many source products are written in one database transaction. Keep it small: catalog_product_link is read on every product page.

group.label: Co-Purchase Mining
group.comment: Counts how often products were bought in the same order. This is what Frequently Bought Together (and any rule using the Bought together strategy) is built from. Counts are stored per month: the first run backfills the whole look-back window, after that only the current month (and briefly the previous one) is recomputed each night.

field.label: Look-back Window (months)
field.comment: How far back pair counts are kept and summed. Older months are pruned.

field.label: Minimum Orders per Pair
field.comment: Two products must have been bought together in at least this many orders before they count as a pair. 1 links anything ever bought together once; higher is stricter but needs more order history before anything shows.

field.label: Maximum Orders per Run
field.comment: Safety bound on the mining query. If a month holds more orders than this, the run processes what fits and says so in the log.

field.label: Skip Orders With More Lines Than
field.comment: The number of pairs an order produces grows with the square of its line count, so one very large order can dominate the whole aggregate. Orders above this many lines are ignored.

field.label: Co-Purchase Mining Schedule (cron expression)
field.comment: Default "0 3 * * *". Must run before the rule job below.

field.label: Rule Run Schedule (cron expression)
field.comment: Default "30 3 * * *". Schedule it after the co-purchase job and after the catalog reindex, so it works from current prices and a current aggregate.
